name: mcp-tools
intro: Every tool of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers XTM One exposes for OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenCRQ: 164 tools. An assistant or an agent of your own calls them with an API key of a user, and works with that user's rights in each product: see [MCP servers](/develop/apis/mcp/) for the endpoints, the protocol and the authentication. A tool marked Write changes data; a read-only key cannot call it.
filter: Filter by tool or by what it does

sections.title: OpenCTI server
